title: GeoVision AI Real-Observation Environmental Validation Dataset
description: Independently interpreted real-world reference samples for Pune and Western Maharashtra catchments, evaluated against Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical imagery via Google Earth Engine.
provenance_statement: Independent reference evidence curated from documented hydrological gauge records, JRC Global Surface Water history, Forest Survey of India compartments, NICFI/PlanetScope imagery inspection, and District Mining Office lease surveys. Kept strictly separate from the Random Forest training set and the synthetic simulation fixture.

samples.reference_source: Khadakwasla Hydrological Gauge & Pune Irrigation Dept Record
samples.reference_interpretation_method: Hydrological station gauge height comparison and shoreline multi-temporal satellite delineation
samples.reviewer_notes: Reservoir post-monsoon storage level shift produced 0.20 km² exposed shoreline inundation expansion relative to 2023 baseline.
samples.inclusion_exclusion_reason: Verified authoritative reference evidence and clear dry-season dual-satellite acquisition.

audit_trail.audit_rationale: Seasonal post-monsoon reservoir storage drawdown and shoreline mudflat exposure is hydrological recession, not flood inundation. Conflating normal dry-season storage recession with flood disasters is scientifically invalid. Live GEE confirms 0.000 km² optical flood expansion.

audit_statement: Forensic audit #3.4.1 corrected ground-truth conflations: dry-season reservoir drawdown was relabeled and excluded from flood inundation metrics; uncorroborated national-scale forest citations were excluded. Predictions are decoupled from reference records and loaded exclusively from authentic GEE observation artifacts.
